result.summary: Unit test run for ISS-0169 tranche 1 (LUA-05/06/07) is green with zero regressions. zig build exit 0. zig build test-lua: 71/71 passed, exit 0. zig build test: 936/1000 passed, 0 failed, 64 skipped, 81/81 steps succeeded, exit 0. Baseline established against a clean worktree of main (b3d406d): 865/929 passed. A per-test-binary diff shows exactly one difference — the branch adds one binary of 71 tests — and every pre-existing binary reports an identical pass count on both sides, so this run introduced NO new regression. All 18 new blocks in src/lua/capability_enforcement_test.zig execute (0 SkipZigTest) and are wired via src/lua_test_root.zig. The 64 skips are PRE-EXISTING (same count on main). One PRE-EXISTING defect was discovered while building the baseline and filed and forwarded, not fixed here: ISS-0175 / GH #503, vendor/luajit/src/luajit_relver.txt is git-ignored yet required by vendor/luajit/build.zig, so a fresh clone cannot build test-lua.

issues.description: LuaJIT build input vendor/luajit/src/luajit_relver.txt is ignored by vendor/luajit/src/.gitignore line 3 but consumed as a required build input by vendor/luajit/build.zig line 79, and nothing in the Zig build generates it. A clean clone or fresh worktree therefore cannot build test-lua, failing with "failed to check cache: ... luajit_relver.txt file_hash FileNotFound". Discovered while creating the main baseline worktree required by this step. Filed as GH #503 and added to the global queue at MAJOR; not fixed in this run per the filed-and-forwarded scope boundary.
